Alex P.: quick heads-up — saw a reproducible quality delta when we flipped on fp8 kernels for Cedar-7B-v1.2 in shadow mode on H100. brief numbers: ROUGE-L down ~1.8 pts, ExactMatch down ~2.4%, ppl +6.2%.
Maria G.: can you paste the eval harness config and the exact binary/commit?
Alex P.: running against eval-harness v0.9 + our local scoring; shadow run tag `fp8-shadow-3419`. commit `a9f3d2c` (runtime-kernels). config snippet:```
model: cedar-7b-v1.2
precision_policy: fp8_enabled
kernel_selector: auto
seq_len_buckets: [128,512,1024,2048]
batching: {max_batch_tokens: 4096, prefer_latency: true}
```
Sam K.: what's the sequence-length distribution in the shadow traffic? long prefixes?
Alex P.: short summary: 72% <=512, 20% in 513-1024, 8% >1024. the regressions correlate with the >512 bucket.
Alex P.: pasted a small runtime log snippet showing the switch behavior:```
[2026-03-18T14:22:13Z] selector: chose mixed-prec-path for seq=768 batch=1
[2026-03-18T14:22:13Z] kernel-loader: applied fp8-kernel v2.1
[2026-03-18T14:22:13Z] kv-cache: fallback to fp16-accum for layer 24 due to saturating accumulator
[2026-03-18T14:22:13Z] numeric-check: activation-scale jump on layer 24 -> triggering per-layer re-quantization
```
Casey L.: sounds like a precision fallthrough: selector picks fp8 kernels but for some layers we take fp16 accumulation fallback which changes accumulation semantics and causes small numeric bias over long prefixes. are we seeing it only on long contexts?
Alex P.: yes — short contexts look fine. long-context examples show prefix degeneration and slightly different token probabilities; manifests as hallucination uptick in answer tasks.
Maria G.: can we mitigate quickly by enforcing a strict selector policy that disables fp8 for seq > 512 or forces `strict_precision_handshake: true`?
Casey L.: quick patch to runtime we can toggle via config:```
precision_switch_policy: "strict"
fp8_fallback_threshold: 0
force_fp16_on_long_seq: true
```
Casey L.: that will avoid mixed handshake but loses some perf on midsize sequences. tradeoff: remove quality regression now, then optimize later.
InfraBot: shadow run checkpoint: recorded 3419876543 -> job fp8-shadow-3419 started on h100-pool-3, nodes=4.
Maria G.: ok create a short rollback/mitigation playbook and open a ticket (assign to eng-ml + infra). include recommended canary gating: 1) block fp8 for seq>512 2) enable numeric-telemetry (per-layer activation scales) 3) run targeted eval set for long-context QA.
Alex P.: will open ticket + attach small harness PR with a reproducible seed + failing example. plan: switch config in canary to strict policy, re-run shadow for 12h, then iterate on per-layer scaling fix.
Sam K.: also add a smoke test that runs model with a 1500 token prefix and compares logits before/after kernel switch (diff threshold 1e-4).
Alex P.: ack, i'll add smoke and tag @Casey L. for the runtime patch review.
Maria G.: thanks — this looks actionable. :thumbsup:
